::: {.hero-banner}
# EcoCast Plus
### Operational Dynamic Ocean Management
<p class="lead">Delivering real-time species distribution models to support sustainable fisheries and protected species conservation across U.S. waters.</p>
:::

::: {.column-page-inset}

::: {.grid .gap-4}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### About the Initiative
EcoCast Plus represents the next generation of dynamic ocean management tools. By integrating real-time oceanographic data from Copernicus Marine Service (CMEMS) and ROMS models, we generate daily predictive surfaces for target catch and bycatch species.

Our goal is to provide industry and management with the tools needed to maximize fishing opportunity while minimizing interactions with protected species.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### System Status
::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
## **System Operational**
* **Data Feeds:** CMEMS & ROMS Live
* **Last Update:** `r Sys.Date()`
* **Active Regions:** West Coast, Gulf of Mexico
:::
